notes: Residual Effectiveness v2.2: the v2.1 architecture (B(h) = frozen baseline, G(h, r) = LoRA + residual head) with a stronger ranking term. The pairwise ranking loss weights each pair by its rollout success-rate gap. lambda_rank and the number of epochs are chosen on TRAIN only by cross-validation over histories (scripts/train_residual_cv.py); DEV is evaluated once for the chosen model.

predictor.pilot_decision: 2026-10-01 user decision: v2.2 keeps the v2.1 architecture and strengthens response ranking; lambda_rank chosen by TRAIN cross-validation, DEV read once at the end

selection.notes: 3 folds by case over the TRAIN histories. A (lambda, epoch) candidate is admissible when its held-out AFTER NLL is within nll_tolerance of the lowest one; among those the highest held-out within-history ordering wins, then delta sign accuracy. Fixed before any result.

training.training_notes: ranking.lambda is replaced by each candidate during cross-validation and by the chosen value in the final run. gap_weighted: a pair's weight is the difference of its rollout AFTER rates. Learning rates and regularization as in v2.1.
